system.description:
Manufactured by Ayelixe/Krongbing Textiles, the Shipsuit is a multipocketed coverall made of a tough Synthmesh fabric, which has been known to last through years of regular use. A fitted coverall can also be used as a envirosuit in an emergency, although a separate Life Support system such as a Breath Mask is required.

A Shipsuit provides enough pockets and pouches to carry up to 24 objects of Small size and weighing no more than 1 kg each. The cumulative weight of the objects is halved for the purpose of calculating the wearer's total Carried Weight. A character wearing a Shipsuit receives a +1 Equipment bonus to his or her Fortitude Defense when resisting Extreme Temperatures.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Unknown Regions
